title: Microsoft Copilot in Business Central: What the New Unified Chat Experience Means
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 public preview brings a unified Copilot-style chat that reasons over Business Central data together with web search results and general knowledge. It is available to all Business Central license holders, with extra benefits such as Work IQ for Microsoft Copilot license holders. Once rolled out, administrators might have to switch it on from the Copilot & Agent Capabilities page.
key_points: The chat combines Business Central data, web search results and general AI knowledge in one conversation
Any Business Central license gives access; Microsoft Copilot licenses add benefits such as Work IQ
After rollout, administrators may need to enable it on the Copilot & Agent Capabilities page and should review AI governance policies
The feature is in public preview, so availability and behavior may change
The post frames it as part of aligning Business Central with the wider Copilot and agent ecosystem, affecting developers, consultants and admins

quotes.text: After it is available in an environment, administrators may need to enable it on the Copilot & Agent Capabilities page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical for administrators implementing the feature, identifying where enablement occurs
